summary: The pinned implementation has gaps in reviewer-history isolation, environmental applicability, failed-evidence retention, interrupted decision recording, and removal of the legacy merge API.

criteria.title: Planning and milestone authority
criteria.explanation: Planning and human-authority checks are present, but milestone eligibility can accept stale Verification after an execution-relevant environment variable changes. The core's applicability comparison does not detect that change when environmentKeys is omitted.
evidence: Read-only diagnostic: an environment-sensitive command changed from exit 0 to exit 1 while executionEnvironment returned the identical fingerprint.

criteria.title: Model-led execution
criteria.explanation: Readiness records intent without launching execution. Gates can be requested independently, genuine Verification inputs remain required for spec/Judge, and no remediation-round counter imposes a halt.

criteria.title: Canonical layouts
criteria.explanation: The trusted resolver separates canonical feature records from selected application repositories. Current evidence storage and finalization do not require an evidence commit or a Git repository owning the records.
evidence: cli/test/current-core.test.js: parent Git tracked/ignored records fixtures

criteria.title: Exact source and requirements
criteria.explanation: Candidates retain base/head source bytes, exact requirement hashes and lengths, feature/repository identities, selected criteria, and implementation-authority references. Preparation and admission check current requirements and repository policy.

criteria.title: Containment and isolation
criteria.explanation: Canonical-file traversal and symlink protections are implemented, but tracked history is exported as ordinary source. The filter admits the current feature's old review/advisory packets and every other feature's journals and retained objects.
evidence: Read-only excluded() diagnostic returned false for docs/issues/feature/code-review.md, docs/issues/feature/pr-12/judge.json, docs/issues/feature/advisory/round-1.md, docs/issues/other/events.jsonl, and docs/issues/other/.gatereeve-current/objects/abc.

criteria.title: Publication and retention
criteria.explanation: Exclusive publication, integrity checking, and recovery mechanisms are present. However, failed specification validation is thrown away before its proof is retained, and failed reconciliation receipts become unreferenced objects rather than retained result evidence.
evidence: Read-only in-memory validateSpec diagnostic with unavailable Python observed zero proof-object publications and zero appended events.

criteria.title: Local finalization
criteria.explanation: The current packet and retention operations derive their inventories from recorded references and validate their closure locally. Application cleanliness, pinned heads, PR synchronization, and reviewed-content integration checks remain enforced.

criteria.title: Independent grouped verdicts
criteria.explanation: Separate code/spec verdicts, fresh-context checks, receipt bindings, and missing-verdict handling are implemented and exercised. The criterion still fails its input-isolation condition because unselected tracked history enters the evaluator's source view.

criteria.title: Complete obligation inventory
criteria.explanation: The enabled default obligations remain individually represented, including an additional independent Judge, actual runner Verification, reconciliation, triage, explanation, packet integrity, release, and finalization. Optional whiteboard remains explicitly selected.

criteria.title: Equivalent-input reuse
criteria.explanation: Identical source content at a new SHA can reuse original proof. However, unrelated tracked review reports and other features' journals are included in source identity, so changing those records forces refreshed proof despite unchanged application inputs.
evidence: Read-only excluded() diagnostic confirmed that unrelated report and journal paths remain included.

criteria.title: Relevant change and uncertainty
criteria.explanation: Source, requirements, installed dependencies, and declared runtime inputs are checked conservatively. Undeclared environment variables are nevertheless inherited by commands while being omitted from applicability identity, allowing a relevant or uncertain environment change to be treated as equivalent.
evidence: Diagnostic command: process.exit(process.env.GATEREEVE_CHECK_MODE === String(1) ? 0 : 1); values 1 and 0 produced exits 0 and 1 with the same environment fingerprint.
cli/test/current-core.test.js:581-593 tests declared variables and incidental variables, but not an undeclared variable that affects the command.

criteria.title: Targeted delta coverage
criteria.explanation: Delta admission binds prior qualifying proof and both candidates, exports prior source endpoints, checks changed-path coverage and interaction statements, and retains original provenance. Cross-repository and base-only changes have explicit negative coverage scenarios.

criteria.title: Bounded history and dispositions
criteria.explanation: The explicit history packet labels claims, checks open findings and affected closures, and permits justified carry-forward. Its bounds are bypassed by ordinary source export, which exposes old reports and unrelated journals independently of history selection.

criteria.title: New discovery and blocking criteria
criteria.explanation: New findings remain reportable, including findings using an existing class identity. Blocking findings must name in-scope source and an approved criterion or gate rule; advice can remain nonblocking.

criteria.title: One scoped human decision
criteria.explanation: Successful decisions preserve provenance and reconcile repeats. A combined amendment/implementation instruction is validated before any durable decision record, however; validator failure or interruption leaves neither the instruction nor a visible incomplete operation. Waiver-plus-acceptance similarly checks continuation before recording the decision.
evidence: cli/test/current-core.test.js:315-327 covers successful amendment and retry, not interruption before recording.
Approved spec C5 requires repeat-safe internal steps and visible incomplete status after interruption.

criteria.title: Honest exceptions and integration
criteria.explanation: The current core preserves original outcomes, displays exceptions separately, limits their applicability to equivalent candidate content, and requires distinct acceptance and exact-action merge authority. Actual integration is independently observed.

criteria.title: Enforcement coverage
criteria.explanation: The new action adapter and narrow host hooks consult the core and report their limits honestly. The distributed Python merge API remains callable and performs merges without consulting current milestone evidence, leaving a second GateReeve action path outside that enforcement.

criteria.title: Coherent consumers and low ceremony
criteria.explanation: CLI, native plugins, and desktop share the current core, and incidental ordering controls are removed. Failed reconciliation loses the validator's useful cause: the result retains only a generic UNAVAILABLE summary, with no linked failed proof or error details for consumers to inspect.
evidence: Canonical and staged desktop protocol files were compared and had no differences.

criteria.title: Direct cutover
criteria.explanation: The CLI legacy merge subcommand refuses execution, but the shipped, importable merge_pull_request implementation remains operational and is still tested as a successful merge API. Retiring only its command-line dispatch does not remove the parallel execution path.
evidence: .gatereeve-agent-evidence/patches/feature.json: pr_lifecycle.py diff changes the CLI dispatch while retaining the function.

criteria.title: Resume without false history
criteria.explanation: Resume establishes a durable current run without replaying old journals, retains prior activation references, requires observed planning authority, and reports unsupported proof as missing. Existing planning documents are preserved.

criteria.title: Practical observations
criteria.explanation: Current receipts expose available timing, token, cost, and outcome data while leaving missing metrics null. Result inspection and documented real-project use require no benchmark, pilot, dashboard, or additional metrics gate.

scopeCheck.explanation: The 306 changed files concern the approved core cutover, native/CLI/desktop consumers, generated projections, packaging closure, documentation, and verification. No unrelated application feature or unauthorized publication action was identified.
evidence: .gatereeve-agent-evidence/inventory.json: 99 modified, 157 deleted, 50 added; no binary entries or renames.
.gatereeve-agent-evidence/patches/feature.json: all 46 offset-bound chunks verified against their hashes and assembled material hash.
Approved spec: Scope and verification boundaries.
Canonical and staged desktop protocol contents match.

gapCheck.explanation: Required behavior remains incomplete for filtered reviewer history, conservative environmental applicability, retained failed validator evidence, durable incomplete decisions, and exclusive use of the current merge path.
evidence: Approved spec C2-C6 and rubric R5, R6, R11, R13, R15, R17-R19.
The formal Verification suites do not establish these uncovered scenarios; the environment diagnostic demonstrates a counterexample.

contradictionCheck.explanation: Actual behavior contradicts the approved bounded-history, relevant-input, failure-retention, incomplete-decision, and direct-cutover contracts. The amendment error also describes authorization as retained before the code has recorded it.
evidence: plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/current/environment.js:53-55 and execution.js:151-152 versus approved spec C4.

findings.summary: F1: Tracked history bypasses bounded reviewer context and unnecessarily invalidates proof.
evidence: evidence.js:13-21 excludes a short list only beneath the active feature home. It admits that feature's code-review.md, pr-12/judge.json, advisory/round-1.md, and workflow-model.lock.json.
The same filter admits other features' events.jsonl and entire .gatereeve-current object areas.
evidence.js:28-34 captures those blobs; execution.js:63-66 exports every captured base/head file into the evaluator view without history selection or claim labeling.
Read-only calls to the pinned excluded() function confirmed each admitted path.
Those blobs also participate in contentIdentity, so unrelated report/journal changes invalidate otherwise equivalent proof.

findings.summary: F2: Runner reuse ignores inherited environment variables that affect check outcomes.
evidence: environment.js:53-55 hashes only explicitly selected environmentKeys, defaulting to none.
execution.js:151-152 launches checks without an explicit env, so they inherit process.env.

A read-only diagnostic ran the same Node command with GATEREEVE_CHECK_MODE=1 and =0. Its exit codes were respectively 0 and 1, while both execution fingerprints were sha256:f7c8ab196a7561f316bc1ee250f2e459bb92d6b37d052caf46cca75cc33a93c9.
core.js:253-255 accepts that unchanged fingerprint; execution.js:341-355 can consequently reuse the prior PASS.

findings.summary: F3: Failed deterministic validator evidence is discarded or orphaned.
evidence: core.js:171-174 rejects a failed spec validator before putJson(proof) or any result/event publication.
A read-only in-memory harness of validateSpec with unavailable Python observed zero retained proof objects and zero appended events; details existed only in the transient error.
execution.js:447-449 stores a reconciliation proof and then throws on failure without attaching that reference to the error.

execution.js:420-430 retains only error.artifacts/providerFailure and error.message, leaving reconciliation diagnostics unlinked and replacing the actual failed check with a generic UNAVAILABLE summary.

findings.summary: F4: Combined human decisions have no durable incomplete state before validation or continuation.
evidence: core.js:134-148 constructs an amendment and runs specification validation before recording DECIDED at line 162.
Failure or interruption during that work leaves the observed instruction, old/new commitment association, and pending continuation unrecorded.
core.js:146 says 'retained authorization can be retried' although no decision has yet been retained.
Waiver-plus-acceptance also evaluates continuation at line 156 before recording the underlying instruction.
The successful-repeat amendment test at current-core.test.js:315-327 does not exercise this interruption window.

findings.summary: F5: A shipped legacy merge API still executes outside the current core.
evidence: pr_lifecycle.py:80-117 retains merge_pull_request, which accepts a nonempty authorization string, performs Git/PR checks, and calls provider.gh('pr', 'merge', ...) without current milestone admission.
test_pr_lifecycle.py:159-171 imports and successfully invokes this API without establishing a current run or current gate evidence.
The feature diff retires only main()'s merge dispatch at pr_lifecycle.py:159; the importable merge implementation remains callable.
No hosted merge was performed during this review.

findings.summary: The full bound Verification report and runtime attachment were inspected; their stated limits remain material.
evidence: runtime.png SHA-256 matched bed1a98508e488b34ec2be4c90f4bec96ec49c922a9eb43b6c5d40ddcdadc64a and was visually inspected.
The report records 252 CLI passes, 172 desktop checks, 62 Python passes, native package validation, a universal macOS build, ARM64 packaged runtime smoke, and a real fresh Codex evaluator receipt.
The live receipt assesses a small code-only fixture; it is not feature acceptance or a live grouped code/spec exercise.
The report expressly excludes exact-current hosted CI, native Intel runtime repetition, and live installed-host hook activation. Full suites were not rerun in this read-only review.

markdown:
**FAIL — pinned feature acceptance**

Reviewed `643e3ea2b03f19b66595219c4f8df934596aa436` → `b1d83440b4c44b77793895ef3297be2e9462d46a` at FEATURE_FINAL scope. All 21 frozen rubric IDs were evaluated. The approved spec/design, inventory, full digest-bound Verification report, and `runtime.png` attachment were read. The 46 patch chunks were verified and assembled to the declared material hash. The inventory contains 306 files: 99 modified, 157 deleted, and 50 added, with no binaries or renames.

The formal Verification report records 252 CLI passes, 172 desktop checks, 62 Python passes, native package checks, a universal macOS build, ARM64 packaged runtime smoke, and a fresh native Codex evaluator receipt. Its limits are explicit: no exact-current hosted CI, repeated native Intel launch, or live installed-host hook activation. The live evaluator receipt covers a small code-only fixture. These results do not establish the uncovered paths below. Full suites were not rerun; additional diagnostics were read-only.

For source references below, `P` means `plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/current/`.

| ID | Result | Assessment and evidence |
|---|---|---|
| R1 | FAIL | Stale Verification can remain eligible after a relevant inherited environment change. `P/environment.js:51-69`, `P/core.js:253-255,298-309`; F2. |
| R2 | PASS | Readiness launches no evaluator, independent work has no universal ordering, typed Verification inputs remain, and no round cap exists. `P/core.js:184-190`, `P/execution.js:232-255`; current-core readiness and alternate-order fixtures. |
| R3 | PASS | Canonical records work independently of application Git, including parent/no-Git and tracked/ignored layouts. `context.js:resolveWorkflowContext`, current-core layout and local-finalization fixtures. |
| R4 | PASS | Source endpoints, exact requirements, scope, criteria, and authority references are retained and checked. `P/evidence.js:sourceCandidate/checkCandidate`, `P/core.js:176-182`. |
| R5 | FAIL | Old review packets and other features' journals/objects enter ordinary source export. `P/evidence.js:13-34`, `P/execution.js:60-66`; F1. |
| R6 | FAIL | Exclusive publication and integrity checks exist, but failed spec proof is discarded and reconciliation proof becomes orphaned. `P/core.js:164-174`, `P/execution.js:420-449`; F3. |
| R7 | PASS | Current packet/retention operations validate recorded closure locally, while application cleanliness and PR/integration checks remain. `P/execution.js:coreEvidence`, `P/evidence.js:assertClean`, `P/actions.js`. |
| R8 | FAIL | Separate verdict and fresh-receipt machinery works, but reviewer input isolation fails through tracked history. `P/execution.js:97-134`, grouped-verdict tests, bound live receipt; F1. |
| R9 | PASS | The old default obligations map to explicit current gates, including separate Judge and actual runner proof. Deleted default-policy patch and `P/contracts.js:GATES`. |
| R10 | FAIL | Identical-tree SHA reuse works, but unrelated tracked reports/journals enter content identity and force reruns. `P/evidence.js:13-34,contentIdentity`, `P/core.js:263`; F1. |
| R11 | FAIL | Undeclared variables affect inherited runner execution without affecting applicability. `P/environment.js:53-55`, `P/execution.js:151-152`; F2. |
| R12 | PASS | Delta records bind prior proof and candidates, cover changed paths/interactions, and preserve provenance. `P/execution.js:changedPaths/validateVerdict/input.prior`; cross-repository and base-only delta fixtures. |
| R13 | FAIL | Explicit history selection and dispositions are bounded, but ordinary source export bypasses those bounds. `P/execution.js:selectedHistory`, `P/evidence.js:13-34`; F1. |
| R14 | PASS | New findings and old-class instances remain reportable; blocking findings require approved criteria and in-scope source. `P/execution.js:169-225` and new-discovery/disposition fixtures. |
| R15 | FAIL | Combined decisions are validated before durable recording, leaving no incomplete operation after failure/interruption. `P/core.js:134-162`; F4. |
| R16 | PASS | Current exceptions preserve FAIL/UNAVAILABLE, have content scope, and do not infer merge authority; integration is observed separately. `P/contracts.js:waiverFor`, `P/core.js:150-159,307-319`, `P/actions.js:observeIntegration`. |
| R17 | FAIL | The new adapter/hooks consult the core, but the shipped Python merge API does not. `scripts/pr_lifecycle.py:80-117`, its successful API test, and workflow inventory; F5. |
| R18 | FAIL | Consumers share the current core and remove ordering controls, but failed reconciliation loses its useful validator cause and linked receipt. `P/execution.js:420-449`; F3. |
| R19 | FAIL | The legacy CLI dispatch refuses execution while the inventoried, importable legacy merge implementation remains operational. `scripts/pr_lifecycle.py:80-130,153-159`; F5. |
| R20 | PASS | Resume preserves old files, establishes durable current activation, uses observed authority, and does not replay old passes. `P/core.js:73-110`, `P/store.js` activation methods and resume fixtures. |
| R21 | PASS | Available metrics and outcomes remain inspectable; missing metrics are null and no benchmark/pilot gate was added. `local-agent-adapters.js:providerMetrics/receiptFor`, `P/adapter.js:readCurrent`, workflow observation guidance. |

**Supported findings**

1. **F1 — Tracked history bypasses reviewer isolation and reuse boundaries.** `P/evidence.js:13-21` filters only a short list beneath the active feature. Direct read-only calls confirmed that `code-review.md`, `pr-12/judge.json`, `advisory/round-1.md`, and `workflow-model.lock.json` remain included. Other features' `events.jsonl` and `.gatereeve-current/objects/*` also remain included. `P/execution.js:63-66` exports those captured files without bounded history selection or claim labeling. Their bytes also enter source identity, so unrelated record changes invalidate otherwise equivalent proof. This violates C2-C4 even though the explicit history packet has appropriate controls.

2. **F2 — Environment-sensitive failures can reuse an earlier PASS.** `P/environment.js:53-55` defaults `environmentKeys` to an empty list, while `P/execution.js:151-152` inherits the process environment. A read-only diagnostic ran the same Node check with `GATEREEVE_CHECK_MODE=1` and `=0`: exits were 0 and 1, but both fingerprints were `sha256:f7c8ab196a7561f316bc1ee250f2e459bb92d6b37d052caf46cca75cc33a93c9`. `P/core.js:253-255` therefore cannot distinguish these relevant inputs, and the reuse path can retain the old PASS. The existing environment test covers declared variables and incidental changes, not this counterexample.

3. **F3 — Failed validator evidence is discarded or orphaned.** `P/core.js:171-174` throws on failed specification validation before retaining the proof or appending an outcome. A read-only in-memory harness with unavailable Python observed zero proof publications and zero events; diagnostics existed only in the transient error. Reconciliation separately stores its proof at `P/execution.js:448`, then throws without attaching it to the result. The catch at lines 420-430 keeps only a generic UNAVAILABLE summary and lacks the failed receipt reference and useful validator details. Failure history is consequently incomplete even though successful evidence publication is carefully protected.

4. **F4 — Combined decisions lack durable incomplete status.** An amendment that also authorizes implementation runs validation at `P/core.js:145-148`, before `DECIDED` is appended at line 162. Failure or interruption leaves no retained instruction or pending continuation, despite the error describing authorization as retained. Waiver-plus-acceptance likewise checks continuation before recording the instruction. Successful repeat handling does not cover this C5 interruption requirement.

5. **F5 — A parallel legacy merge API survives distribution.** `scripts/pr_lifecycle.py:80-117` still exposes `merge_pull_request`, which can reopen, ready, check, and merge a PR using a nonempty authorization label and Git/PR checks without current milestone admission. The file remains in `workflow-inventory.json:219`; `test_pr_lifecycle.py:159-171` successfully invokes the API without current-run gate evidence. The feature patch retires only command-line dispatch at line 159. This is a remaining callable GateReeve merge implementation outside the shared core. No hosted merge was performed during this review.

| Explicit check | Result | Explanation |
|---|---|---|
| Scope | PASS | Changes stay within the approved core, consumers, projections, packaging, documentation, and verification scope. |
| Gaps | FAIL | F1-F5 leave required isolation, applicability, retention, interruption recovery, and direct-cutover behavior incomplete. |
| Contradictions | FAIL | Actual export/reuse/decision behavior contradicts C2-C5, and the retained legacy merge API contradicts the one-current-path requirement in C6. |

The Verification report and attachment hashes match their bound references. Its successful checks remain useful evidence, but the supported counterexamples prevent feature acceptance.
